defects.title: A disabled user's existing session keeps working
defects.steps: Create user → sign in (token) → admin sets status DISABLED → call GET /api/v1/workforce/employees with the old token
defects.actual: 200 OK — the token works until it expires (JWT_TTL=12h). New sign-ins are refused correctly.
defects.evidence: api-functional › Audit & Administration (existing session of disabled user is cut off → 200)
defects.fix: In authenticate(), reject tokens whose user is no longer ACTIVE (cache status in Redis for a few seconds), or keep a per-user token version and bump it on disable/role change/password reset.

retest.note: Old token refused straight after the account is disabled: 200 before, 401 immediately after and 6 s later.

defects.title: Admin can book overlapping time off for the same person
defects.steps: POST /workforce/time-off for an employee (15–16 days out), approve → POST another for days 16–17
defects.expected: 400/409 overlap (self-service already blocks this: 'You already have … that overlaps these dates')
defects.actual: 201 Created — double-booked leave, double-counted balance and pay
defects.fix: Run the same overlap check used by POST /me/time-off inside POST /workforce/time-off (and in bulk/import paths).

retest.note: A second, overlapping admin booking now returns 409 with a clear message naming the existing vacation.

defects.title: Administrator uses a password on the app's own blocklist and is never asked to change it
defects.expected: Strong password; temporary/bootstrap passwords force a change
defects.actual: Password is in EASY list of passwordPolicy.ts and contains the username; mustChangePassword=false
defects.fix: Rotate before go-live. Apply checkNewPassword() to BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD and set must_change_password=true for the bootstrap admin.

retest.note: Admin still signs in with the blocklisted bootstrap password and is not asked to change it (mustChangePassword=false). SEC-01 fails.

defects.title: Ctrl+K search shows fake prototype records and cannot find real ones
defects.actual: 'Jane Doe · EMP-1024 · Customer Billing' (does not exist); real group and screen names: 'No matching records'
defects.evidence: admin-e2e A-04, screens/palette-fake-data.png; src/components/common/CommandPalette.tsx uses SEED_EMPLOYEES/SEED_WFM_GROUPS/SEED_SKILLS from src/services/wfmStore.ts
defects.fix: Search the API (or the loaded stores) and the route list; delete the SEED_* data from the production bundle.

retest.note: Prototype SEED_ data is gone. In the live palette "Jane" and "Voice Inbound" now find nothing, while "Agent1" lists the real employees, "Demo Support" the real group and "Shift Templates" the screen; Enter opens the result.

defects.title: Admin sidebar cannot be used with a keyboard or screen reader
defects.steps: Load any admin screen → press Tab repeatedly
defects.actual: Only 1 focus stop in the sidebar in 40 Tabs — items are <div onClick> with no role or tabindex
defects.fix: Render items as <a href> (they already have URLs) or <button>, with aria-current on the active one.

retest.note: Sidebar items are now focusable buttons: Tab reaches Overview, Workforce, Employees, Teams, Skills and the rest (A-03 passes).

defects.title: Icon-only buttons have no accessible name on every admin screen (WCAG 4.1.2, critical)
defects.steps: axe-core WCAG 2.1 AA scan of all 51 admin screens
defects.actual: button-name: 530 elements on 51/51 screens; plus select-name and missing form labels on one screen
defects.fix: Add aria-label to icon buttons (lucide icons inside <button>), label selects/inputs.

retest.note: Unnamed buttons are gone: 530 elements on 51 screens down to 0. Still 6 form fields without labels on Administration > Alerts & reports (critical "label" rule).

defects.title: AG Grid Enterprise runs without a licence key
defects.actual: Console prints the AG Grid Enterprise licence banner; grids show the trial watermark
defects.evidence: admin-crawl console errors on Employees, Time Off, Attendance, Timeline, Live coverage, Activities
defects.fix: Set VITE_AG_GRID_LICENSE for the production build (or switch to the Community edition). Using Enterprise in production unlicensed breaches the licence.

retest.note: ag-grid-enterprise is still a dependency, there is no licence key in any env file, and the licence banner is still logged on 4 screens (Employees, Time off, Attendance, Activities).

defects.title: CSV formula injection in the audit export
defects.actual: Written raw: "=HYPERLINK(""http://evil.example/…"")" — runs when opened in Excel
defects.fix: Reuse csvCell from modules/reports.ts (prefix = + - @ with ') in auditRoutes.ts and integrations/runner.ts and any other CSV writer.

retest.note: The audit CSV now writes the team name with a leading apostrophe ('=HYPERLINK...), so spreadsheets show it as text.

defects.title: Session token accepted in the URL (?token=) on every REST route
defects.actual: 200; the web app also opens /ws?token=<jwt>
defects.fix: Accept ?token= only on the WebSocket upgrade, ideally with a short-lived single-use ticket instead of the session JWT; strip it from access logs.

retest.note: GET /users?token=<valid JWT> now returns 401.

defects.title: Response time reveals whether a username exists
defects.steps: POST /auth/login with a wrong password for a real vs an unknown username (5 each)
defects.actual: Real user median ≈ 808 ms, unknown ≈ 11 ms (bcrypt only runs for real users)
defects.fix: When no user is found, bcrypt.compare against a fixed dummy hash before failing.

retest.note: Median sign-in time is 293 ms for a real user and 301 ms for an unknown one.

defects.title: Impossible calendar date returns 500 and leaks the PostgreSQL error
defects.actual: 500 'date/time field value out of range: "2026-02-30"'
defects.fix: isoDay is a regex only — add a real-date refine to the shared isoDay schema (affects every date input), and never return raw DB messages on 500.

retest.note: 2026-02-30 now returns 400 "One of the values is not valid (check dates and numbers)." with no database text.

defects.title: Failed sign-in attempts are not written to the audit log
defects.steps: Fail a sign-in for admin → search audit
defects.actual: Only successful LOGIN is audited (lockouts are in Redis only)
defects.fix: Audit failed attempts and lockouts (needed for SOC 2 / ISO 27001 evidence).

retest.note: A failed admin sign-in now appears in the audit log.

defects.title: Forecast Builder takes ~34 s to finish loading
defects.steps: Open /forecasting/forecast-builder for Demo Support (10 weeks of history, one queue)
defects.actual: GET /forecast/history-quality takes 15–32 s and is requested twice on every load
defects.fix: Cache history-quality per group/version, compute it in the background, and de-duplicate the request in the screen.

retest.note: History-quality API answers in 21 ms (2 ms cached); Forecast Builder settles in 6.6 s on the dev server (was about 34 s).

defects.title: Forecast/schedule engine crashes with a native abort inside the CP-SAT solver, and stays down
defects.steps: Seen twice: (1) during scripts/demo-seed.mjs (forecast → schedule); (2) during the gateway's own test run, seconds after 'cancel stops a running build inside the engine' passed, while the next multi-group solve ran
defects.expected: A failed solve fails that one request; the engine keeps serving
defects.actual: 'Fatal Python error: Aborted' in ortools cp_model.Solve (backend/engine/scheduling.py:465, solve_cpsat) with the new cancel watchdog thread (scheduling.py:459, solver.StopSearch from another thread) alive. The whole process dies: every forecast and schedule request then returns 503 until someone restarts it. Earlier dead engines also left 3 hung server.py processes (each with 4 workers) running. Not reproduced on demand: 3 rounds of start → cancel → solve passed
defects.evidence: engine-crash-1.log (native stack of all threads); gateway-suite.txt (12 tests failed with ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE after the crash); /health engine:false
defects.fix: Run each CP-SAT solve in a child process (the ProcessPool already exists) so a native abort kills one job, not the server; re-check the uncommitted StopSearch-from-watchdog change (prefer a solution-callback stop or the solver's own time limit); run the engine under a supervisor that restarts it and kills the whole process tree; alert on /health engine:false.

retest.note: Crash injection: the CP-SAT solver process was killed mid-build. The engine stayed up (0 restarts), the build fell back to HiGHS and finished DONE ("cpsat: failed (the solver process ended without an answer)", "highs: feasible"). Each solve now runs in its own process.

defects.title: Admin JavaScript is a single 4.2 MB chunk (1.18 MB gzipped)
defects.expected: Route-level code splitting, main chunk < 500 kB
defects.actual: index.js 4,234 kB + exceljs 940 kB; Vite warns about chunk size
defects.fix: Lazy-load each module screen (React.lazy) and exceljs/recharts/ag-grid only where used.

retest.note: Screens are now lazy-loaded: entry chunk 282 kB (87 kB gzip) across 35 chunks. AG Grid (2.7 MB) and exceljs (940 kB) load only on screens that use them.

defects.title: Employee list is not paginated
defects.actual: 328 kB per call; 40 req/s with p95 627 ms at 25 concurrent
defects.fix: Server-side paging and field selection; the grid can use the AG Grid server-side row model.

retest.note: ?limit= and ?offset= are now accepted, but paging happens after a capped 2,000-row load: x-total-count says 2000 on a 50,656-person tenant, offset 40000 returns 0 rows, and 50 rows cost the same ~500 ms as 2,000. Push LIMIT/OFFSET (or keyset paging) into the SQL and return the true total (see scale DEF-29).

defects.title: Portal is not usable on a phone browser
defects.actual: Fixed 224 px sidebar leaves 188 px for content; Schedule scrolls sideways
defects.fix: Collapse the sidebar into a bottom tab bar under md breakpoint (same IA as the mobile app).

retest.note: At 412 px the portal has no sidebar and no sideways scroll; content uses the full width on every section.

defects.title: Colour contrast below WCAG AA on every screen of both apps
defects.actual: 822 elements on 51/51 admin screens; portal login and 4/5 sections
defects.fix: Darken #A3A3A3/#737373 secondary text on white/#FAFAF8 backgrounds.

retest.note: Low-contrast elements roughly halved (822 to 457) but still present on all 51 admin screens; the portal sign-in still has 2.

defects.title: NATS TLS certificate checking is switched off
defects.actual: false
defects.fix: Set to true with a trusted CA for production.

retest.note: backend/.env still has NATS_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=false.

defects.title: Offers show an empty group name to the employee
defects.actual: groupName ""
defects.fix: Join the group name in the /me/offers query.

retest.note: Code check: /me/offers now joins wfm_groups and returns group_name. Not seen live, because the demo agent had no open offers during the run.

defects.title: No URLs per section: reload always returns to Home, Back leaves the app
defects.expected: Stay on Inbox (admin app already has per-screen URLs)
defects.actual: Back on Home; nothing can be bookmarked or linked from a notification e-mail
defects.fix: Use the same History-API routing as src/services/routes.ts.

retest.note: Each portal section has its own URL; reloading on /inbox stays on Inbox (P-08 passes).

defects.title: Time-off form accepts end-before-start until it is submitted
defects.steps: Request time off → Start = day 60, End = day 55
defects.actual: Submit enabled; the server's 400 message is shown afterwards
defects.fix: Validate in the form (it already pre-checks overlaps).

retest.note: The form flags an end date before the start date before it is submitted (P-05 passes).

defects.title: Hire date in 2099 is accepted
defects.fix: Bound hire dates.

retest.note: Hire date 2099-01-01 now returns 400 "hireDate must be between 1950 and a year from now".

defects.title: Malformed JSON returns error code INTERNAL
defects.actual: 400 with code INTERNAL
defects.fix: Map body-parser SyntaxError to a 400 BAD_REQUEST code.

retest.note: Broken JSON now returns 400 BAD_JSON.

defects.title: Unauthenticated endpoints reveal account existence and organisation name
defects.actual: Returns the organisation for a real e-mail, [] otherwise (rate-limited 15 per 15 min)
defects.fix: Set LOGIN_DISCOVERY=false for production if the org code is distributed another way.

retest.note: Unchanged (a configuration choice): /auth/discover still returns the organisation for a known login and an empty list for an unknown one; /auth/login-options names the organisation. Set LOGIN_DISCOVERY=false if org codes are handed out another way.

defects.title: No favicon — 404 on every page load
defects.actual: 404 (console error on every screen)
defects.fix: Add a favicon to public/.

retest.note: Both apps link /favicon.svg, served as image/svg+xml.

defects.title: scripts/demo-seed.mjs cannot finish
defects.steps: Run the seed on a stack with FORCE_PASSWORD_CHANGE on (the default)
defects.actual: The giveaway step gets 403 'Choose a new password' (new logins are temporary), and a failed step leaves the group behind so the seed refuses to run again
defects.fix: Change the demo logins' passwords in the seed; make the seed resumable.

retest.note: Code check: the seed now handles the forced password change. Not re-run, because it rewrites the demo data.

defects.title: Existing data to clean before go-live
defects.steps: Configuration › Integration Station; Data Management › Staged imports
defects.actual: A connector points at nats://192.168.9.81:4222 (TIMEOUT); 6 failed history imports (672–5,000 rows rejected); test employees EXT7172 etc.
defects.fix: Start production from a clean database; do not migrate this test data.

retest.note: Still a pre-launch housekeeping item. The database now also holds the 50,000-person SCALE test data and QA- records from both runs.

defects.title: Adherence takes about 2 s per call on a large tenant
defects.steps: GET /intraday/adherence?groupId=<Demo Support> 15 times, on the tenant that now also holds the 50,656-person scale data
defects.expected: Close to the first run (p95 23 ms): the group still has the same people
defects.actual: p50 1,913 ms, p95 2,232 ms. The three SQL queries behind it take about 20 ms in total when run directly as the database owner (row-level security does not apply there), so the time goes on row-level-security checks or work in the gateway. /workforce/employees is 641 ms and 1.6 MB for 2,000 rows, and under 25 parallel requests it manages 1 request per second (p50 15 s, p95 21 s; all 200).
defects.evidence: performance > PERF-01 (re-run on a restarted gateway); EXPLAIN ANALYZE of the adherence queries in psql
defects.fix: Profile the endpoint as the app role (RLS on); make sure the RLS policy uses an indexed, STABLE tenant lookup; add an index on employees(primary_group_id) and a GIN index on eligible_group_ids.

retest.note: Found in this re-test.

defects.title: Gateway process ended once with no log line
defects.steps: Run the API-latency test (12 endpoints x 15 calls) straight after the full suite
defects.expected: The gateway stays up, or logs why it stopped
defects.actual: The process ended with exit code 127 and nothing in its log; the test got ECONNRESET. After a restart the same test ran cleanly, so it did not reproduce.
defects.evidence: The gateway log ends on normal 200 lines; the shell reported exit code 127
defects.fix: Run the gateway under a process manager that restarts it, and log uncaughtException, unhandledRejection and process exit before quitting.

retest.note: Found in this re-test; seen once.

defects.title: Engine unit tests: 3 of 91 fail after the solver change
defects.actual: 88 passed, 3 failed. test_a_failing_primary_falls_through_to_the_next_solver and test_every_solver_failing_still_ends_with_the_greedy_roster stub solve_cpsat, but the solver now runs in a separate process the stub never reaches (both pass with ENGINE_ISOLATE_SOLVES=0). test_no_history_changes_nothing is flaky: the same request can give a different roster (it failed 1 of 2 times in-process).
defects.evidence: pytest output saved as static/pytest-rerun.txt in the QA run folder
defects.fix: Stub solve_cpsat_isolated (or set ENGINE_ISOLATE_SOLVES=0) in those two tests; fix the CP-SAT random seed and use 1 search worker in the determinism test.

retest.note: Found in this re-test.

strengths: Role-based access control: 1,934 role × route checks over 327 guarded routes and 6 roles — no route answered without its permission, no role wrongly blocked, every guarded route returns 401 when signed out.
Token security: alg:none, role-swapped payload, bad signature, expired and garbage tokens all rejected; sign-out revokes the token server-side.
Brute force: sign-in locks after 10 failures per IP+user; password change locks after 5; password policy rejects short, common, username-based and repeated-character passwords.
Injection: SQL-injection probes on sign-in, search and IDs gave no 5xx and no bypass; HTML in names and reasons renders as text (no dangerouslySetInnerHTML anywhere).
Tenant/employee isolation: an agent cannot see, cancel or give away another agent's requests or shifts; mass-assignment fields are ignored.

Validation is strong across configuration (duplicates, time zones, SL > 100 %, queue hours), templates, forecast lifecycle (no publish before approve, no deleting a published forecast) and live feeds (negative volume, future events, unknown agents).

Scheduling quality: published 2-week schedule (282 shifts, 30 people) has 0 double-bookings, ≥ 11 h rest everywhere, ≤ 48 h/week, ≤ 6 days in a row; swap takes are refused when they would break rest/hours rules.
Self-service flows work end-to-end in the portal: forced first-login password change, time off (auto-approval by policy, overlap check), giveaways, VTO accept, overtime decline, inbox, sign-out.
API reads are fast (most 4–55 ms p95) and returned no 5xx under 25-way concurrency.
Headers: Helmet CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, nosniff, no X-Powered-By; CORS allows only the admin origin.
Builds and checks: TypeScript clean in admin, portal and gateway; both production builds succeed; no secrets in the bundles; engine unit suite 91/91.
verdictLine: Both critical defects and 18 others are fixed and checked. Three high items remain open, and none needs a large change: rotate the bootstrap admin password and force a change (DEF-03, a setting); add an AG Grid licence key or move to the Community edition (DEF-07, a setting or purchase); and label the last 6 form fields on Alerts & reports (DEF-06, a small code fix). Close those and NATS certificate checking (DEF-19), and this gate is a GO. The 50,000-person scale findings in the separate report still stand.
